composers_checked.name: Louis Ferdinand, Prince of Prussia
composers_checked.note: All ten chamber works are on the Hänssler complete-works set and on MDG/Thorofon discs.

note: Mid slice with no benchmarks and no violin cross-listings. Hoffmeister: 'not performed or recorded' rests on Deezer, Apple Music, MusicBrainz and web searches (Oct 2026); the name is swamped by Mozart's K. 499 'Hoffmeister' quartet and the Hoffmeister Quartet (an ensemble), so these negatives are weak and a pass with named players should overturn them. Judgement calls: (1) IMSLP's unnumbered Vienna-manuscript double bass quartet (3 movements) is taken as No. 1 of the BIS numbering: a BIS booklet (seen only in a search snippet) says the first quartet's manuscript was rediscovered at the Vienna Gesellschaft der Musikfreunde; Nos. 3 and 4 have their own IMSLP pages and No. 2 has four movements, so No. 2 is added without an IMSLP page. (2) The IMSLP clarinet-quartet page is Pleyel's second book, Nos. 4–6 of six; recorded complete by Vanoosthuyse and the Zemlinsky Quartet. (3) The four trios for two flutes and cello are recorded on Bongiovanni as 'Op. 31 Nos. 1–4' (IMSLP: Op. 7); matched by key and tempo markings. (4) Flute Quintet H. 5905/4 (C major) is matched to the Tudor oboe-quintet No. 6 via the Haynes number noted on IMSLP; medium confidence. (5) Krumpholz Op. 12 Nos. 2–4 count as chamber music only if Szabadi and Onczay play the ad lib. parts on the Hungaroton disc, which the Naxos listing and a review imply but I could not confirm track by track. (6) Benda's two sonatas with string quartet come from the 'Sammlung vermischter Clavierstücke'; the Part 3 strings are not on IMSLP. (7) Louis Ferdinand's Octet Op. 12 is F major in the Hänssler and Ear Sense listings, while IMSLP's key tag reads 'f'; Op. 11 is given with double bass or second cello as in the Thorofon recording. (8) Edelmann's Op. 14 No. 2 and Op. 15 No. 4 pass on one documented professional concert (Leclair Consort, Budapest Music Center, 10 Feb 2025); no recording and no modern edition of these works was found (the CMBV edition is of the orchestral Op. 12 concerto). Not checked: the Georg Benda E-major trio sonata (catalogue blocked), concert performances of any skipped Hoffmeister work.
